Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

FERROSILICO-ZIRCONIUM 

( First Revision ) 



IS : 30T1 .1973 

( Reaffir med J985 ) _

1 . Scope — Requirements of ferro-silico-zirconium used in iron and steel industry, 

2. Grades — - Ferro-silico-zirconium shall be of three grades as specified in Table 1 . 

3. Supply of Material 

3.1 General Requirements — According to IS : 1387-1967 'General requirements for the supply of metal- 
lurgical materials (first revision)' . 

3.2 The material shall be supplied in the form of properly cleaned lumps free from any slag and non-metallic 
residues. 

4. Chemical Composition — The chemical composition of the material when determined in accordance 
with IS : 3294 'Methods of chemical analysis of ferro-silico-zirconium {under preparation)' , shall be as 
given in Table 1 . Till IS : 3294 is published, the method of chemical analysis shall be as agreed to 
between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 



TABLE 1 CHEMICAL COMPOSITION OF FERRO-SILICO-ZIRCONIUM 


Grade Designation

FeZr38Si50 350 to 400 


470 to 520 0-50 


— 


80 to 120 



5. Size — As agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 

6. Packing and Marking 

6.1 Packing — The material shall be supplied, packed in suitable containers in quantities, mutually agreed 
to between the purchaser and the manufacturer. 

6.2 Marking — The material shall be marked with the following details : 

a) Manufacturer's name or trade-mark, and 

b) Grade designation. 

6.3 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

7. Sampling — In accordance with IS : 1472 (Part l)-1959 'Methods of sampling ferro-alloys, Part I'. 



Adopted 26 December 1 973

be determined by any established instnimental/chemical method. Referee 
method shall be agreed to between the purchaser and the manufacturer.'
